llm_response.reason: The website makes unrealistic claims about rapid AI certification (in 7 days), provides ambiguous privacy and business information, omits any verifiable organizational background, and was registered very recently with heavy privacy protection. Tactics include promises of credibility without substantiation and targeting psychological urgency. Payment and contact information are not shown, no third-party reviews or endorsements can be found, and there is no evidence of legitimate institutional affiliation or regulatory oversight. These match several key scam indicators including fraudulent offers, unverifiable company background, psychological manipulation, and lack of transparency.
